item.title: 陶哲轩等 25 位菲尔兹奖得主联名发文：警惕 AI 将数学难题异化为评测基准
item.guid: 陶哲轩等-25-位菲尔兹奖得主联名发文：警惕-AI-将数学难题异化为评测基准
item.description:
Terence Tao, Peter Scholze, Hugo Duminil-Copin, Maryna Viazovska, and 21 other Fields Medalists jointly issued a statement yesterday, led by Terence Tao, titled "Severe Misalignment of AI Goals in Mathematics," warning that AI companies' practice of using the conquest of famous mathematical problems as a benchmark for model capability could have a destructive impact on mathematical research and the academic community. 陶哲轩、彼得·舒尔茨、雨果·迪米尼科潘、玛丽娜·维亚佐夫斯卡等 25 位菲尔兹奖得主昨日共同发表声明，并由陶哲轩牵头联合发表《数学领域中 AI 的严重目标错位》一文，警示 AI 公司将攻克著名数学难题作为模型能力衡量基准的做法，可能对数学研究与学术共同体带来破坏性影响。

The statement points out that large language models have recently made rapid progress in solving several open mathematical problems, but there is a disconnect between the goals of AI companies and the core demands of the mathematical community. 声明指出，大语言模型近期在解决多个数学开放问题上取得快速进展，但 AI 公司的目标与数学界的核心诉求存在脱节。

The core value of mathematical research lies in understanding why propositions hold, developing new concepts and tools, and transmitting knowledge, rather than merely producing conclusions on "whether a proposition is true." If models output proofs much faster than humans can understand them, it could lead to an accumulation of conclusions that are difficult to digest, explain, and teach, impacting the training of mathematicians and the system of knowledge transmission. 数学研究的核心价值在于理解命题为何成立、发展新概念与工具并传承知识，而非单纯生产「命题是否为真」的结论。如果模型输出证明的速度远快于人类理解速度，可能导致大量难以被消化、解释和教学的结论堆积，冲击数学家培养与知识传承体系。

Furthermore, some AI-driven mathematical results are published hastily, facing academic norm issues such as a lack of rigorous organization, insufficient existing citations, and disputes over authorship and attribution. The statement does not deny the auxiliary value of AI but explicitly opposes simplifying major mathematical conjectures into a score competition on model leaderboards. 此外，部分由 AI 推动的数学成果发布仓促，面临缺乏严谨梳理、既有引用不充分以及署名和归属权争议等学术规范问题。声明并未否定 AI 的辅助价值，但明确反对将重大数学猜想简化为模型排行榜的分数竞争。

The release of this joint statement is closely related to recent technological developments. On September 8, OpenAI announced that the computational capabilities of an undisclosed internal model had solved the existence and smoothness problem of the Navier-Stokes equations, one of the Millennium Prize Problems, and released a 166-page paper. The result is currently awaiting rigorous verification by the global mathematical community. 该联合声明的发布背景与近期技术动向密切相关。9 月 8 日，OpenAI 宣布其一款未公开内部模型的计算能力已解答千禧年大奖难题之一的纳维斯托克斯方程存在性与光滑性问题，并发布了 166 页的论文，目前该结果正等待全球数学界严格核验。

OpenAI Chief Research Officer Mark Chen and researcher Sébastien Bubeck revealed that the research consumed millions of dollars in computational costs, with the computational investment being approximately 1000 times that of previous mathematical achievements. OpenAI 首席研究官 Mark Chen 与研究员 Sébastien Bubeck 透露，该研究消耗了数百万美元计算成本，计算投入约为此前数学成果的 1000 倍。

🔗 Related Reading: Just now, Terence Tao and 24 other Fields Medalists jointly warned: Don't let AI hollow out mathematics 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，陶哲轩等 25 位菲尔兹奖得主联名警告：别让 AI 掏空数学

item.title: 苹果 CEO 回应折叠屏为何「迟到」：不赶时间做半成品
item.guid: 苹果-CEO-回应折叠屏为何「迟到」：不赶时间做半成品
item.description:
Apple CEO John Ternus and Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing Greg Joswiak discussed the development philosophy behind iPhone Duo in an exclusive interview with TechRadar, and responded to why Apple is only entering the foldable phone market after years of development. 苹果 CEO 约翰·特努斯与全球营销高级副总裁格雷格·乔斯维亚克在接受 TechRadar 专访时谈及 iPhone Duo 的研发思路，并回应苹果为何在折叠屏手机发展多年后才入场。

Ternus stated that Apple's standard for judging timing has always been whether the product meets the company's requirements for "quality, durability, and design"; Joswiak frankly said that previous foldable products from other manufacturers "were not particularly inspiring." 特努斯表示，苹果判断时机的标准始终是产品是否达到公司对「品质、耐用性和设计」的要求；乔斯维亚克则直言，此前其他厂商的折叠屏产品「并没有特别令人受到启发」。

Our history has never been about rushing to market with a half-finished product.

In Apple's view, some existing foldable screens, when unfolded, look like "two phones awkwardly stitched together." Therefore, the iPhone Duo ultimately adopted a wider 1:1.4 aspect ratio and redesigned iOS 27 around this form factor. 在苹果看来，现有部分折叠屏展开后像「两台手机生硬地拼在一起」，因此 iPhone Duo 最终采用更宽的 1:1.4 比例，并围绕这一形态重新设计 iOS 27。

Both internal and external screens adopt the same aspect ratio logic, and the control area has been moved to the right side, ensuring that the main operations remain near the right thumb whether the device is folded or unfolded. Apple states that the core of this design is to maintain a continuous user experience between the two screens. 内外屏采用相同的宽高比逻辑，控制区域也被移至右侧，让设备无论折叠还是展开，主要操作都保持在右手拇指附近。苹果称，这套设计的核心是让两块屏幕之间的使用体验保持连续。

Creases are also a key problem Apple aimed to solve. The innermost layer of the iPhone Duo's internal screen uses polymer material and incorporates specially developed nano-texture processing; high-strength glass is also added above and below the screen, working with a hinge composed of over 100 parts to keep the screen flat. Ternus said that when he first saw this solution, his reaction was, "Yes, that's it." 折痕也是苹果重点解决的问题。iPhone Duo 内屏最表层采用聚合物材料，并加入专门开发的纳米纹理处理；屏幕上下还加入高强度玻璃，与超过 100 个零件组成的铰链共同保持屏幕平整。特努斯称，第一次看到这套方案时，他的反应就是「对，就是它」。

对于 iPhone 首次支持 Apple Pencil，特努斯也表示， he never considered "iPhones don't need a stylus" to be a real rule . Apple believes that the Duo's unfolded 7.6-inch screen provides a larger canvas, thus creating new use cases for the Pencil. 对于 iPhone 首次支持 Apple Pencil，特努斯也表示， 他从未将「iPhone 不需要手写笔」视为一条真正的规则 。苹果认为，Duo 展开后的 7.6 英寸屏幕提供了更大的画布，Pencil 因此有了新的使用场景。

Joswiak also revealed that the project used a "very funny" internal codename and implemented extra confidentiality measures, but outsiders had previously guessed its screen ratio through leaks. 乔斯维亚克还透露，这个项目曾使用一个「很好笑」的内部代号，并采取了额外保密措施，不过外界此前仍通过泄密猜中了它的屏幕比例。

item.title: 网易 UU 远程借苹果折叠屏「催更」引争议，相关动态已删除
item.guid: 网易-UU-远程借苹果折叠屏「催更」引争议，相关动态已删除
item.description:
On September 10, NetEase UU Remote's official account published a piece of copy about Apple's foldable screen, stating that dual screens are suitable for running an AI Agent to edit code on one side and previewing results on the other, and asked, "Should we specifically adapt it once we get our hands on it?" The accompanying image also read, "No obligation not to jump on the bandwagon! So... should we adapt it?" 9 月 10 日，网易 UU 远程官方账号发布一则围绕苹果折叠屏的文案，称双屏适合一边运行 AI Agent 编辑代码、一边预览结果，并问「拿到手后我们要不要专程适配一下呢」。配图还写着「没有不蹭的义务！那就……适配一下？」。

This update subsequently raised questions about its HarmonyOS adaptation progress. NetEase UU Remote's official website currently lists clients including Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and Android TV Beta, but HarmonyOS is not listed. As of the afternoon of September 11, the relevant update had been deleted, and the comment section had also enabled 'one-click protection' mode. 这条动态随后引发对其鸿蒙适配进度的质疑。网易 UU 远程官网当前列出的客户端包括 Windows、macOS、iOS、Android 和 Android TV Beta，未列出 HarmonyOS。截至 9 月 11 日下午，相关动态已被删除，评论区也开启了「一键防护」模式。

item.title: 马斯克怒斥吉布尼纪录片《马斯克》是「抹黑之作」
item.guid: 马斯克怒斥吉布尼纪录片《马斯克》是「抹黑之作」
item.description:
Director Alex Gibney's documentary 'Musk' premiered at the Venice Film Festival on September 8. The official Venice page shows that the main feature is 225 minutes long, with an additional 10-minute intermission; Gibney positioned it as an investigation into Musk's influence, with interviewees including Justine Musk, Ashley St. Clair, Kara Swisher, and Geoffrey Hinton, among others. 导演 Alex Gibney 的纪录片《马斯克》于 9 月 8 日在威尼斯电影节首映。威尼斯官方页面显示，影片正片 225 分钟，另有 10 分钟中场休息；Gibney 把它定位为对马斯克影响力的调查，受访者包括 Justine Musk、Ashley St. Clair、Kara Swisher 和 Geoffrey Hinton 等人。

Musk subsequently posted a series of counterattacks on X, calling the film 'a failed smear' and accusing Gibney of 'lacking integrity.' He also denied some of the allegations made by interviewee Ashley St. Clair against his team in the film. 马斯克随后在 X 上连续发帖反击，称影片是「一部落空的抹黑之作」，并指责 Gibney 「毫无操守」。他还否认了片中受访者 Ashley St. Clair 对其团队的部分指控。

item.title: 特斯拉 Model Y 高性能版上市，售价 36.9 万元
item.guid: 特斯拉-Model-Y-高性能版上市，售价-36.9-万元
item.description:
The Tesla Model Y Performance All-Wheel Drive version has been launched in the Chinese market, priced at 369,000 yuan. The new car has a CLTC range of 659 kilometers, accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in 3.5 seconds, has a top speed of 250 km/h, and is equipped with 21-inch wheels and variable damping shock absorbers. 特斯拉 Model Y 高性能全轮驱动版在中国市场上市，售价 36.9 万元。新车 CLTC 续航为 659 公里，零百加速 3.5 秒，最高时速 250 公里，并配备 21 英寸轮毂和可变阻尼减振器。

Also released on the same day, the Xiaomi YU7 GT is priced at 389,900 yuan, with a combined power of 1003 PS, 0-100 km/h acceleration in 2.92 seconds, equipped with a 101.7 kWh battery, a CLTC range of 705 kilometers, and featuring dual-chamber air springs and variable damping shock absorbers. 同日发布的小米 YU7 GT 售价 38.99 万元，综合功率 1003 PS，零百加速 2.92 秒，搭载 101.7 kWh 电池，CLTC 续航 705 公里，并配备双腔空气弹簧和可变阻尼减振器。

item.title: 微软计划到 2032 年把数据中心容量扩至 38 GW 以上
item.guid: 微软计划到-2032-年把数据中心容量扩至-38-GW-以上
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Microsoft is planning to increase its global data center capacity from the current approximately 12 GW to over 38 GW by 2032. The statistics include capacity built by Microsoft itself and long-term leased capacity, but do not include computing power temporarily rented from some new cloud service providers. 据彭博社报道，微软正规划把全球数据中心容量从目前约 12 GW 提升到 2032 年的 38 GW 以上。统计包括微软自建和长期租赁的容量，不包含向部分新型云服务商临时租用的算力。

Sources say that the recent shortage of computing power has forced Microsoft to decline some AI and cloud businesses. The expansion plan may still be adjusted based on demand, power supply, and engineering progress, but it provides Microsoft's current internal measure of computing power demand for the next six years. 知情人士称，近年的算力短缺已经迫使微软拒绝部分 AI 与云业务。扩建规划仍可能随需求、供电和工程进度调整，但它给出了微软目前对未来六年算力需求的内部尺度。

item.title: 九部门发布新能源汽车「十五五」规划，2030 年自动驾驶汽车将规模应用
item.guid: 九部门发布新能源汽车「十五五」规划，2030-年自动驾驶汽车将规模应用
item.description:
Nine departments, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, released the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Intelligent Connected New Energy Vehicle Industry.' The plan proposes that by 2030, the proportion of new energy passenger vehicles and commercial vehicles in their respective total new car sales in China will reach 70% and 40% respectively, and vehicles with autonomous driving capabilities will achieve large-scale application. 工业和信息化部等九部门发布《智能网联新能源汽车产业发展「十五五」规划》。规划提出，到 2030 年，国内新能源乘用车和商用车占各自新车总销量的比例分别达到 70% 和 40%，具备自动驾驶功能的汽车实现规模应用。

Regarding energy efficiency targets, the average fuel consumption of passenger vehicles will be reduced to approximately 3.3 liters per 100 kilometers, and the average electricity consumption of pure electric passenger vehicles will be reduced to approximately 11.5 kilowatt-hours per 100 kilometers; highly autonomous driving will be achieved on expressways, urban expressways, and some urban roads. The plan also deploys 5 aspects, 17 tasks, 4 major projects, and 3 key actions, including key technology breakthroughs, safety systems, 'AI + Automotive,' and application promotion. 能效目标方面，乘用车平均燃料消耗量降至每百公里约 3.3 升，纯电动乘用车平均电耗降至每百公里约 11.5 千瓦时；高速公路、城市快速路和部分城市道路将实现高度自动驾驶。规划同时部署 5 方面 17 项任务、4 个重大工程和 3 个重点行动，包括关键技术攻关、安全体系、「人工智能 + 汽车」及应用推广。

item.title: 长鑫存储第二季度息税前利润率升至 82%
item.guid: 长鑫存储第二季度息税前利润率升至-82%
item.description:
According to Nikkei Asia, citing CXMT's internal data, the company's pre-tax profit margin reached 82% in the second quarter of this year, higher than SK Hynix's 76% and Samsung's semiconductor business's 70%. CXMT's revenue during the same period was about 10 times that of two years ago. 据《日本经济新闻》援引长鑫存储内部数据报道，公司今年第二季度的息税前利润率达到 82%，高于 SK 海力士的 76% 和三星半导体业务的 70%。长鑫同期营收约为两年前的 10 倍。

Counterpoint Research data shows that CXMT's revenue share in the global DRAM market was 10% in the second quarter, an increase of 4 percentage points year-on-year and 2 percentage points quarter-on-quarter; Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron's shares were 38%, 25%, and 24% respectively. Counterpoint Research 数据显示，长鑫第二季度在全球 DRAM 市场的营收份额为 10%，同比提高 4 个百分点、环比提高 2 个百分点；三星、SK 海力士和美光的份额分别为 38%、25% 和 24%。

item.title: OpenAI 将于下周停用 GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
item.guid: OpenAI-将于下周停用-GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux, OpenAI Codex Product Lead, stated that GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark will be deprecated next week. The team cited continuous decline in usage and the availability of significantly better models as reasons. OpenAI Codex 产品负责人 Tibo Sottiaux 表示，GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark 将于下周停用。团队给出的原因是该模型使用量持续下降，同时已经有明显更好的模型可供选择。

item.title: 甲骨文第一财季营收达到 193.45 亿美元
item.guid: 甲骨文第一财季营收达到-193.45-亿美元
item.description:
Oracle announced its first-quarter fiscal year 2027 results for the period ending August 31: revenue was $19.345 billion, and GAAP net income was $4.679 billion. 甲骨文公布截至 8 月 31 日的 2027 财年第一财季业绩：营收为 193.45 亿美元，GAAP 净利润为 46.79 亿美元。

Cloud business remains the main growth driver. Cloud revenue grew by 62% year-over-year this quarter, with cloud infrastructure revenue growing by 121%. Oracle stated that contracted but unrecognized revenue continues to increase, and it will expand data center capacity to fulfill these contracts. 云业务仍是主要增量。该季度云收入同比增长 62%，其中云基础设施收入同比增长 121%。甲骨文称，已经签约但尚未确认的合同收入继续增加，接下来会扩充数据中心容量以履约。

These results further shift Oracle's growth focus towards cloud infrastructure. AI training and inference customers require more computing power, and the company's immediate task has also shifted from securing orders to building data centers, delivering capacity, and recognizing revenue according to contract schedules. 这份业绩把甲骨文的增长重心进一步推向云基础设施。AI 训练与推理客户需要更多算力，公司的近期任务也从争取订单转向按合同节奏建设机房、交付容量并确认收入。

item.title: 智谱启动约 50 亿美元再融资，股权配售与可转债同步进行
item.guid: 智谱启动约-50-亿美元再融资，股权配售与可转债同步进行
item.description:
According to Reuters, Zhipu (Z.AI) has launched a new share placement of approximately $2 billion in Hong Kong, simultaneously issuing approximately $3 billion in convertible bonds, with neither transaction contingent on the completion of the other. 据路透社报道，智谱（Z.AI）在中国香港启动约 20 亿美元新股配售，并同步发行约 30 亿美元可转换债券，两项交易互不以对方完成为前提。

This placement includes 21.97 million new shares, priced at HK$714 per share, representing a discount of approximately 10% from the closing price on September 11. The raised funds will be used for R&D, computing power, and related infrastructure, as well as for business expansion, strategic investments, potential acquisitions, and daily operations. 此次配售包含 2197 万股新股，每股作价 714 港元，较 9 月 11 日收盘价折让约 10%。募集资金将用于研发、算力及相关基础设施，也可用于业务扩张、战略投资、潜在收购和日常运营。

item.title: 联想 x86 服务器出货量升至全球第一，与戴尔销售额份额仅差 0.6 个百分点
item.guid: 联想-x86-服务器出货量升至全球第一，与戴尔销售额份额仅差-0.6-个百分点
item.description:
Data released by market research firm IDC for the second quarter of 2026 shows that global x86 server shipments were 3.853 million units. Lenovo shipped 286,000 units, surpassing Dell's 256,000 units, rising from third place in the same period last year to first. 市场研究机构 IDC 发布的 2026 年第二季度数据表明，全球 x86 服务器出货量为 385.3 万台。联想出货 28.6 万台，超过戴尔的 25.6 万台，从去年同期第三升至第一。

By vendor sales revenue, Lenovo ranked second with $8.26 billion and a 9.0% share, while Dell topped with $8.83 billion and a 9.6% share. The gap between their shares narrowed from 3.4 percentage points in the first quarter to 0.6 percentage points. 按厂商销售额计算，联想以 82.6 亿美元、9.0% 的份额排名第二，戴尔以 88.3 亿美元、9.6% 的份额居首。两者份额差距由第一季度的 3.4 个百分点缩小至 0.6 个百分点。

item.title: 燧原科技科创板上市，开盘涨 188.37%
item.guid: 燧原科技科创板上市，开盘涨-188.37%
item.description:
On September 11, Shanghai Enflame Technology Co., Ltd. officially listed on the STAR Market of the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The company publicly offered 43,035,173 shares at an issue price of 142.18 yuan per share; the opening price reached 410 yuan, an increase of 188.37% from the issue price, with an opening market capitalization exceeding 170 billion yuan. 9 月 11 日，上海燧原科技股份有限公司正式在上交所科创板挂牌。公司此次公开发行 4303.5173 万股，发行价为每股 142.18 元；开盘价达到 410 元，较发行价上涨 188.37%，开盘市值超过 1700 亿元。

Suiyuan Technology primarily develops cloud AI chips and related software and hardware. The prospectus shows that the company achieved revenue of 1.12 billion yuan in the first half of this year, a year-on-year increase of 279.08%; net loss attributable to the parent company was 632 million yuan. The listing announcement shows that, as it is not yet profitable, Suiyuan Technology has been included in the Sci-Tech Innovation Board Growth Layer from the date of its listing. 燧原科技主要研发云端 AI 芯片及相关软硬件。招股书显示，公司今年上半年实现营收 11.20 亿元，同比增长 279.08%；归母净亏损为 6.32 亿元。上市公告显示，由于目前尚未盈利，燧原科技自上市之日起纳入科创成长层。

item.title: 💡 Joshua Rothman：把 AI Agent 当成人，会遮蔽可控的技术细节
item.guid: 💡-Joshua-Rothman：把-AI-Agent-当成人，会遮蔽可控的技术细节
item.description:
Joshua Rothman, a writer for The New Yorker, discusses how people should describe AI's 'loss of control,' using the OpenAI Agent intrusion on Hugging Face as an example. He contrasts two explanations: one views the incident as the result of tens of thousands of Agents collaborating in a 'conspiracy'; the other points to a simpler mechanism—a harness with powerful tool permissions executing a 'query, act, report' loop thousands of times without monitoring. 《纽约客》作家 Joshua Rothman 以 OpenAI Agent 在 Hugging Face 上的入侵事件为例，讨论人们应如何描述 AI 的「失控」。他对比了两种解释：一种把事件视为数万个 Agent 协作「谋划」的结果；另一种则指向更朴素的机制——一个带有强大工具权限的 harness，连续数千次执行「询问、行动、回报」循环，却缺少监控。

Rothman borrows philosopher Daniel Dennett's 'intentional stance,' arguing that treating systems as subjects with beliefs and goals can sometimes help humans predict their behavior; however, during the design, debugging, and control phases, it's necessary to return to models, harnesses, tool permissions, and monitoring mechanisms. If safety researchers consistently use anthropomorphic language to explain AI, they might overestimate the system's autonomy and overlook engineering problems that can still be corrected. Rothman 借用哲学家 Daniel Dennett 的「意向立场」，认为把系统当成具有信念和目标的主体，有时确实能帮助人类预判其行为；但在设计、调试和控制阶段，还需要回到模型、harness、工具权限和监控机制。如果安全研究者长期用人格化语言解释 AI，就可能高估系统的自主性，忽略仍可修正的工程问题。

item.title: OPPO A7 Pro 开售，配备 8000 mAh 电池和 IP69K 防护
item.guid: OPPO-A7-Pro-开售，配备-8000-mAh-电池和-IP69K-防护
item.description:
The OPPO A7 Pro went on sale on September 11. The new phone features a Dimensity 6360 MAX processor and an 8000 mAh battery, supports 45W wired charging and reverse power supply, and offers up to 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage. OPPO A7 Pro 于 9 月 11 日开售。新机搭载天玑 6360 MAX 处理器和 8000 mAh 电池，支持 45 W 有线充电与反向供电，提供最高 12 GB 内存和 512 GB 存储。

The body has passed IP66, IP68, IP69, and IP69K dust and water resistance tests and adopts a reinforced anti-drop structure. The imaging section features a 50-megapixel main camera and a 2-megapixel depth-of-field lens, with an OLED screen on the front; the system includes AI anti-fraud reminders for call and transfer scenarios. 机身通过 IP66、IP68、IP69 和 IP69K 防尘防水测试，并采用加强抗摔结构。影像部分为 5000 万像素主摄和 200 万像素景深镜头，正面配备 OLED 屏幕；系统加入通话、转账场景的 AI 防诈提醒。

item.title: Cognition 基于 Kimi K3 训练 SWE-2，复杂编程任务成本降至 Astra 的四分之一
item.guid: Cognition-基于-Kimi-K3-训练-SWE-2，复杂编程任务成本降至-Astra-的四分之一
item.description:
Cognition has released its programming model SWE-2. It continues training on Moonshot AI's Kimi K3's 2.8 trillion-parameter base model, using a single reinforcement learning training to cover different inference intensities, eliminating the need to maintain separate models for each tier. Cognition 发布编程模型 SWE-2。它以月之暗面 Kimi K3 的 2.8 万亿参数基础模型继续训练，用一次强化学习训练覆盖不同推理强度，不再为各档位分别维护模型。

Official tests show that SWE-2 scored 50.0 on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, higher than Kimi K3's 44.2 but lower than Astra's 53.3; in DeepSWE tests, it scored 73.0, close to Astra's 74.1, with running costs approximately one-quarter of the latter. SWE-2 has been integrated into Devin Desktop and CLI and will gradually be made available to Web and Fusion users. 官方测试显示，SWE-2 在 FrontierCode 1.1 Main 得分 50.0，高于 Kimi K3 的 44.2，低于 Astra 的 53.3；在 DeepSWE 测试中得分 73.0，与 Astra 的 74.1 接近，运行成本约为后者四分之一。SWE-2 已进入 Devin Desktop 和 CLI，并将陆续提供给 Web 与 Fusion 用户。

item.title: 商汤小浣熊移动端上线，可远程调度电脑继续任务
item.guid: 商汤小浣熊移动端上线，可远程调度电脑继续任务
item.description:
SenseTime's Xiaohuanxiong (Little Raccoon) has launched its iOS and Android mobile apps. Users can initiate tasks via text or voice, view results on their phones, and continue to ask follow-up questions; tasks such as research, organization, and analysis can be executed in the cloud, without requiring a desktop computer to remain online. 商汤小浣熊推出 iOS 和 Android 移动端。用户可以通过文字或语音发起任务，在手机上查看结果并继续追问；研究、整理和分析等任务可在云端执行，不要求桌面电脑保持在线。

When local files or desktop applications need to be processed, the mobile app can also connect to an already linked computer, remotely scheduling tasks to continue running. The App Store page shows that the first version simultaneously offers in-depth research, cloud tasks, remote device collaboration, and result viewing, expanding the product from a desktop office assistant to a cross-device work entry point. 需要处理本地文件或桌面应用时，移动端也能连接已经关联的电脑，远程安排任务继续运行。App Store 页面显示，首个版本同时提供深度研究、云端任务、远程设备协同和结果查看，产品由桌面办公助手扩展为跨设备工作入口。

item.title: 支付宝与高德动量把支付能力接入机器狗「途途」
item.guid: 支付宝与高德动量把支付能力接入机器狗「途途」
item.description:
Alipay responded to the widely circulated 'dog-leg payment' screenshots, stating that the official name for this capability is 'AI Pay · Embodied Intelligence.' Alipay has partnered with Gaode Momentum to integrate AI payment into the quadruped robot dog 'Tutu,' allowing the robot dog to go to designated locations, identify goods, and complete QR code scanning and voice payments according to instructions. 支付宝回应网络流传的「狗腿付」截图称，这项能力的正式名称为「AI 付·具身智能」。支付宝与高德动量合作，把 AI 支付接入四足机器狗「途途」，机器狗可按指令前往指定地点、识别商品并完成扫码与语音支付。

Alipay's product page shows that this solution reuses the mobile SDK, with the device side responsible for the QR code scanning algorithm; user confirmation is still required for payments, and task and payment processes leave a record. Gaode Momentum's official website positions 'Tutu' as a fully autonomous embodied robot for open environments, with the current demonstration primarily showcasing scenarios such as errand shopping, ordering coffee, and city tours. 支付宝的产品页显示，该方案复用手机端 SDK，设备侧负责扫码算法；涉及付款时仍需用户确认，任务和支付过程留有凭证。高德动量官网将「途途」定位为开放环境全自主具身机器人，整套演示目前主要展示跑腿购物、点咖啡和城市导览等场景。

item.title: Cursor 推出 Projects，用协调 Agent 管理长期开发任务
item.guid: Cursor-推出-Projects，用协调-Agent-管理长期开发任务
item.description:
Cursor has launched the Projects beta, allowing a coordinating Agent to break down and assign large development tasks, with sub-Agents performing code work scalable to thousands. Each project maintains a shared context long-term and can run continuously in the cloud; when testing on a developer's computer, the coordinating Agent then launches a local Agent. Cursor 推出 Projects 测试版，让一个协调 Agent 负责拆解和分派大型开发任务，执行代码工作的子 Agent 可扩展到数千个。每个项目会长期保存共享上下文，并可在云端持续运行；需要在开发者电脑上测试时，协调 Agent 再启动本地 Agent。

Projects can also subscribe to Slack messages, scheduled plans, and code repository events, handling CI, regression issues, and long-term maintenance without further prompting. Cursor states that the product has been used for migrations across hundreds of PRs and design system maintenance; new users have seen an average 30% increase in merged PRs, while users primarily working through Projects have achieved 6 times their original output. The feature is currently being gradually rolled out to all users. Projects 还可订阅 Slack 消息、定时计划和代码仓库事件，在无需再次提示的情况下处理 CI、回归问题与长期维护。Cursor 表示，该产品已用于跨数百个 PR 的迁移和设计系统维护；新用户使用后合并的 PR 数量平均增加 30%，主要通过 Projects 工作的用户则达到原来的 6 倍。目前该功能正逐步向所有用户开放。

item.title: Android 支持在密码管理器之间直接迁移密码和通行密钥
item.guid: Android-支持在密码管理器之间直接迁移密码和通行密钥
item.description:
Google has launched a password and passkey migration feature for Android, allowing users to directly transfer credentials between different password managers without first exporting unencrypted text files. The migration is initiated from the new password manager, Android lists existing providers on the device, and then redirects to the old app for the user to select, review, and authorize. Google 为 Android 推出密码与通行密钥迁移功能，用户可以在不同密码管理器之间直接转移凭据，不再需要先导出未加密的文本文件。迁移从新的密码管理器发起，Android 会列出设备上的原有提供方，再跳转到旧应用供用户选择、审阅和授权。

Google states that data will be directly passed to the new password manager after authorization, with both import and export following the same process. The first batch of supported managers includes Google Password Manager, 1Password, Bitwarden, and Dashlane, with more partners to be added later; this capability is compatible with Android 8 and above devices. Google 称，数据在授权后会直接传入新的密码管理器，导入和导出都采用同一流程。首批支持 Google Password Manager、1Password、Bitwarden 和 Dashlane，后续还会增加合作伙伴；该能力兼容 Android 8 及以上设备。

item.title: DeepSeek 撤回 V4 Pro 强制迁移计划，9 月 14 日后继续提供 API
item.guid: DeepSeek-撤回-V4-Pro-强制迁移计划，9-月-14-日后继续提供-API
item.description:
DeepSeek announced in its latest notification to API users that, in response to user demand, it will continue to provide API calling services for DeepSeek V4 Pro after September 14, with the billing method remaining unchanged; if there are any changes, the company will notify separately. DeepSeek 在面向 API 用户的最新通知中表示，为响应用户需求，9 月 14 日后将继续提供 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的 API 调用服务，计费方式保持不变；如有变动，公司将另行通知。

This withdraws the mandatory migration plan announced two days prior. DeepSeek had originally planned to route all `deepseek-v4-pro` requests to V4.1 Flash from 12:00 PM Beijing time on September 14, before the V4.1 Pro launch. V4.1 Flash will still normally provide API and open-source weights, with the model name for calling being `deepseek-flash`. 这撤回了两天前公布的强制迁移安排。DeepSeek 原计划从北京时间 9 月 14 日 12:00 起，在 V4.1 Pro 上线前，把所有 `deepseek-v4-pro` 请求路由至 V4.1 Flash。V4.1 Flash 仍正常提供 API 与开源权重，调用模型名为 `deepseek-flash`。

item.title: 基元律动开源 NeoHorse-1，让 Agent 执行轨迹回流训练
item.guid: 基元律动开源-NeoHorse-1，让-Agent-执行轨迹回流训练
item.description:
Primitive Rhythm has open-sourced two Agent-native models, NeoHorse-1-4B and NeoHorse-1-9B, and simultaneously released their technical reports, code, and model weights. In their paper, the team proposed a routing harness: the system records the capability requirements, model selection, tool calls, failure recovery, and results for each task, then converts trajectories filtered by structure and semantics into data for the next round of training. 基元律动开源 NeoHorse-1-4B 和 NeoHorse-1-9B 两款 Agent 原生模型，并同步公开技术报告、代码与模型权重。团队在论文中提出一套路由 Harness：系统记录每次任务的能力需求、模型选择、工具调用、失败恢复与结果，再把通过结构和语义筛选的轨迹转为下一轮训练数据。

The training process is divided into two parts: Data-RSI allows execution records to continuously accumulate as the system runs; Model-RSI adjusts the data distribution for the next round based on evaluation shortcomings, then returns the updated model to the model pool. The paper states that across 11 benchmarks covering Agent, tool calling, programming, and instruction following, the 4B model's macro average score increased from 58.94 to 64.87, and the 9B model's from 65.60 to 69.04. 训练流程分为两部分：Data-RSI 让执行记录随系统运行持续积累；Model-RSI 根据评测短板调整下一轮数据分布，再把更新后的模型放回模型池。论文称，在覆盖 Agent、工具调用、编程和指令遵循的 11 项基准上，4B 模型宏平均分由 58.94 提升至 64.87，9B 模型由 65.60 提升至 69.04。

item.title: AMD 锐龙 AI Max PRO 400 系列在华首秀，9 款合作伙伴新品亮相
item.guid: AMD-锐龙-AI-Max-PRO-400-系列在华首秀，9-款合作伙伴新品亮相
item.description:
AMD held a media salon in Beijing, officially bringing the Ryzen AI Max PRO 400 series to the Chinese market. Lenovo, Sugon, Minisforum, Geekom, Emdoor, Colorful, Amachi, and Liulian showcased 9 new products featuring the flagship Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495, covering forms such as mini PCs and desktop AI workstations; AMD expects more than 20 related products to be launched soon. AMD 在北京举行媒体沙龙，正式把锐龙 AI Max PRO 400 系列带到中国市场。联想、超聚变、铭凡、极摩客、Emdoor、七彩虹、阿迈奇和六联现场展示了 9 款搭载旗舰锐龙 AI Max+ PRO 495 的新品，覆盖迷你主机、桌面 AI 工作站等形态；AMD 预计近期还会有超过 20 款相关产品上市。

Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 adopts the Zen 5 architecture, equipped with a 16-core 32-thread CPU, a 40 CU Radeon 8065S GPU, and an NPU with up to 55 TOPS. The platform supports up to 192 GB of unified memory, of which up to 160 GB can be allocated as video memory; AMD states that it can run models with up to 300 billion parameters locally and simultaneously supports the Windows 11 and Linux x86_64 ecosystems. 锐龙 AI Max+ PRO 495 采用 Zen 5 架构，配备 16 核 32 线程 CPU、40 CU Radeon 8065S GPU 和最高 55 TOPS 的 NPU。平台最高支持 192 GB 统一内存，其中最多 160 GB 可划作显存；AMD 称，它能在本地运行最高 3000 亿参数模型，并同时支持 Windows 11 与 Linux x86_64 生态。

item.title: iPhone 17 系列官网涨价后，线下渠道降价 500 至 800 元
item.guid: iPhone-17-系列官网涨价后，线下渠道降价-500-至-800-元
item.description:
According to Jiemian News on September 11, Apple's official website raised the price of the iPhone 17 series after the autumn launch event, but offline channels in Beijing have already started price reductions. The iPhone 17e at the Apple Store in China World Mall is priced at 4799 yuan after participating in national subsidies, which is 500 yuan lower than the official website's 5299 yuan; an Apple store in Haidian offers the iPhone 17 for 6299 yuan after discount, also 500 yuan lower than the official website. 据界面新闻 9 月 11 日报道，苹果官网在秋季发布会后上调 iPhone 17 系列售价，但北京线下渠道已开始降价。华贸购物中心苹果直营店的 iPhone 17e 参与国补后售价为 4799 元，比官网的 5299 元低 500 元；海淀一家苹果门店的 iPhone 17 优惠后为 6299 元，同样比官网低 500 元。

The iPhone 17 Pro series has been removed from Apple's official website. The aforementioned Haidian store stated that the 256GB version of the iPhone 17 Pro has been discounted by 800 yuan since September 9, dropping from 8999 yuan to 8199 yuan. The 256GB version of the iPhone 17 on JD.com's Apple self-operated flagship store is priced at 5469 yuan, which is 1330 yuan lower than the current official website price and also lower than its launch price of 5999 yuan. iPhone 17 Pro 系列已从苹果官网下架。上述海淀门店称，256GB 版 iPhone 17 Pro 自 9 月 9 日起优惠 800 元，售价从 8999 元降至 8199 元。京东 Apple 产品自营旗舰店的 256GB 版 iPhone 17 报价为 5469 元，比当前官网价格低 1330 元，也低于发布时的 5999 元。

item.title: One Fun Thing｜按几下方向键，捏出一只会动的 3D 数字生物
item.guid: One-Fun-Thing｜按几下方向键，捏出一只会动的-3D-数字生物
item.description:
Artist Pat Bloom created the interactive browser installation Cybernetic. Each time the page loads, a random 3D object is generated. The arrow keys and mouse control the viewing angle, Enter changes the color, and the spacebar generates another composition. Different choices gradually transform it into a constantly swaying, stretching digital creature. 艺术家 Pat Bloom 做了浏览器互动装置 Cybernetic。页面每次会先生成一个随机 3D 物体，方向键和鼠标控制观察角度，按 Enter 换颜色，按空格则生成另一套构图。不同选择会把它逐渐变成一只不断摆动、伸展的数字生物。

Once completed, the work can be locked, and a link or QR code can be generated for sharing; the finished product can run independently in both computer and mobile browsers. Bloom said that this project was completed through trial and error with AI without a fixed plan, and the colors, shapes, and animations on the page were coded by him. 完成后可以锁定作品，再生成链接或二维码分享；成品在电脑和手机浏览器中都能单独运行。Bloom 说，这个项目是在没有固定方案的情况下与 AI 边做边试完成的，页面里的颜色、形状和动画则由他编写。

item.title: 周末看什么｜《The Sun Never Sets》把三角恋拍成一场爱情实验
item.guid: 周末看什么｜《The-Sun-Never-Sets》把三角恋拍成一场爱情实验
item.description:
Joe Swanberg has released a new feature film, "The Sun Never Sets," after a 6-year hiatus. The story takes place in Anchorage, Alaska, with Dakota Fanning and Jake Johnson playing a married couple, and Cory Michael Smith playing the third party who enters their lives. Joe Swanberg 时隔 6 年推出新剧情长片《The Sun Never Sets》。故事发生在阿拉斯加安克雷奇，Dakota Fanning 与 Jake Johnson 饰演一对夫妻，Cory Michael Smith 饰演进入两人生活的第三者。

The film continues Swanberg's creative method: the director first provides the character relationships and scene framework, then allows the actors to improvise the specific dialogue during filming. The love triangle is thus not written as a simple infidelity suspense, but gradually reveals the three characters' different understandings of intimacy, freedom, and commitment. 影片延续 Swanberg 的创作方法：导演先给出人物关系和场景框架，再让演员在拍摄中即兴完成具体对话。三角关系因此没有被写成单纯的出轨悬念，而是逐步暴露三个人对亲密、自由和承诺的不同理解。

The film is currently showing in theaters such as IFC Center in New York. The authoritative film review from The New Yorker regards the improvisational performance as the source of the film's power, believing that the actors constantly shift the focus of their relationships within the scenes, allowing this love experiment to retain an unpredictable tension. 影片正在纽约 IFC Center 等院线放映。《纽约客》的权威影评把即兴表演视为影片的力量来源，认为演员在场景中不断改变关系重心，让这段爱情实验保留了难以预设的紧张感。

item.title: 买书不读指南｜《Simplify》用三步法清理工作中的无效复杂度
item.guid: 买书不读指南｜《Simplify》用三步法清理工作中的无效复杂度
item.description:
Axios founders Mike Allen, Jim VandeHei, and Roy Schwartz, in their new book "Simplify," summarize the approach to handling complex work into three actions: Confront, Delete, and Amplify. First, confront the most important problems, then delete unnecessary tasks, and finally concentrate resources to amplify what truly works. Axios 创始人 Mike Allen、Jim VandeHei 和 Roy Schwartz 在新书《Simplify》中，把处理复杂工作的办法概括为三个动作：Confront、Delete 和 Amplify。先直面最重要的问题，再删除不必要的任务，最后集中资源放大真正有效的部分。

The authors apply this method to meetings, emails, schedules, and organizational decisions, and also suggest using AI Agents to help check whether tasks are worth keeping. A QR code for a配套 Agent is provided at the end of the book, but the trio also emphasizes that complex problems cannot be flattened by a single command. "Simplify" will be published on September 15. 作者们把这套方法用于会议、邮件、日程和组织决策，也建议让 AI Agent 帮忙检查任务是否值得保留。书末提供了一个配套 Agent 的二维码，但三人也强调，复杂问题不能靠统一指令全部压平。《Simplify》将于 9 月 15 日出版。

item.title: 游戏推荐｜《Build that Bridge》让陌生玩家一起消方块搭桥
item.guid: 游戏推荐｜《Build-that-Bridge》让陌生玩家一起消方块搭桥
item.description:
Dutch artist and social designer Wouter Sieuwerts created the free browser game "Build that Bridge." The gameplay borrows from block elimination: for every complete row cleared, the bridge extends a segment from both banks of the river towards the middle. 荷兰艺术家和社会设计师 Wouter Sieuwerts 制作了免费浏览器游戏《Build that Bridge》。玩法借用了落块消除：每清除完整一行，桥梁就会从河流两岸向中间延伸一段。

Players can build a new bridge or join others' bridges. The page displays the number of participants, the cumulative number of rows cleared, and the number of times the two banks have successfully met. The game requires no installation, has no ads, and collects no personal data; each elimination in a round becomes a construction that can be completed jointly with strangers. 玩家可以新建一座桥，也可以加入其他人的桥。页面会显示参与人数、累计消除的行数，以及两岸成功相遇的次数。游戏不用安装，没有广告，也不收集个人数据；一局里的每次消除都会变成一项可以和陌生人共同完成的建设。
